name: CVC-ClinicDB: Colonoscopy Polyp Segmentation Dataset
description: CVC-ClinicDB is a canonical biomedical image benchmark for colonoscopy polyp detection and segmentation, developed by researchers from the Computer Vision Center (CVC) at Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona and Hospital Clínic de Barcelona. Standardized for the MICCAI 2015 Endoscopic Video Automatic Polyp Detection challenge, the dataset contains 612 static frames (384x288 resolution) extracted from 29 colonoscopy video sequences. Each frame is accompanied by a ground-truth binary mask indicating the precise pixel-level segmentation of mucosal polyps against the background gastrointestinal lumen. It serves as an essential baseline across modern medical segmentation architectures.
